label: Totally held: in act in a respect and totally held there by another
definition: TotallyHeld InAct H x r: x is in act in respect r (InAct, DEF-ACT) and some z totally holds x in r (TotallyHolds, definition edca52e4-f224-491d-ac45-5816fac1a9fd). It strengthens MOTION_3 holding motion (definition ea1904bc-bdfa-4835-a4a7-8545c5221e2e): whatever is totally held is MOTION_3 held (theorem totallyHeld_held), not conversely, since a thing with two co-holders, or held only by a thing it holds back, is held but not totally held. It is not a further sense of 'being moved' in DISAMB-MOTION; it is MOTION_3 with the holder restricted.
note: Analyst notion, attribution deferred (docs/notes/caused-mover-cstar.md, section 10). Ordinary examples: a lamp hanging from a single hook; under the C* support bundle (accident-inclusive conservation), a thing's lackable acts are held by whatever presently actualizes it as to being, so a holder is then not a total holder of them unless it presently actualizes the held thing as to being (result for TotalHolderOfLackableActGivesBeing).
